title: A longer elastic wire
hook: Change original wire length and predict extension.
misconception: extension stays fixed when original wire length doubles.
objective: Apply ΔL = FL/(AY) to compare extension when original wire length changes, under the stated assumptions.

claims.text: With a uniform wire under fixed tension area and Young modulus in the linear regime, ΔL = FL/(AY). When original wire length doubles, extension becomes 2 times its original value.
claims.source: Idealized model ΔL = FL/(AY); scaling exponent 1. Physics and assumptions await independent review.

recall.question: Consider a uniform wire under fixed tension area and Young modulus in the linear regime, with a nonzero initial result. If original wire length triples from a positive value, what is the multiplier on extension?
recall.why: Apply ΔL = FL/(AY) under the same assumptions: the multiplier is 3.
